title: Garmin Running Dynamics Failure Rate
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:runningdynamics
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(metric_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by run_id
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Garmin running dynamics records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each run.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize metric_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per run.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully which parts of your Garmin running dynamics data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
